Before you head out

Good to Know

The short answers — straight, no guesswork.

Where is Mo'Lisa's located?

There's no fixed address — Mo'Lisa's is a mobile food trailer based in Augusta, GA, that sets up at events around town. Follow @2tieturner on TikTok or call 706-535-8371 to find the current stop.

What are the opening hours?

Hours are event-based and change with each stop, so there's no fixed schedule. A quick call or a look at TikTok before you head out is the surest way to catch the window open.

Can I book the trailer for my event?

Yes — the trailer appears at events around Augusta. Send the details through the booking form above, email MoLisasfood@gmail.com, or call 706-535-8371.

What's on the menu?

Gumbo, shrimp po'boys, fried chicken wings, fish, Philly sandwiches, Voodoo eggrolls and the Dirty Cabbage eggroll — New Orleans eats and a whole lot more. See the full menu above.
